reuse.why: The flag is threaded through the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and setBulkAverage helpers, with a shared BulkBudgetArgs type, but copyPreviousMonth (also month-wide) is not given the flag and keeps its own hidden filter.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is changed once, inside the shared SQL of getBulkBudgetCategories; the diff adds no copied logic.

placement.why: The rule change sits in the shared category-selection helper in budget/actions.ts, where this tree keeps it.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing plus a matching test extension.

maintainability.why: Clean parameter on one helper and one args type, but one month-wide action is left out of the new option and the edited lines are not formatted like the rest of the file.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All edited actions go through getBulkBudgetCategories; copyPreviousMonth's separate getBudgetData filter predates the change and is untouched.
